brief:
Gaza's petroleum authority announced the arrival of four cooking gas trucks, which will be distributed to approximately 8,833 beneficiaries according to approved lists, Shehab Wire reported. The shipment marks a fresh supply of fuel to the territory amid ongoing shortages.

The authority outlined a distribution mechanism targeting specific categories of beneficiaries identified on verified rosters. Details on the timeline and locations for distribution were not immediately specified.
